reuse.why: The flag is implemented as a parameter of the existing getBulkEditableCategories selection that setZero, the N-month averages and last-month spending already share; copyPreviousMonth keeps its pre-existing own filter loop and gets a parallel edit.

duplication.why: No new copied block, but the hidden-category decision (now with its include flag) is still made in two places: the helper's SQL and copyPreviousMonth's inline check.

placement.why: The rule change sits in the shared category-selection helper in budget/actions.ts, and the shared MonthWideArgs type groups the common argument shape.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, the selection helper and one test are touched.

maintainability.why: Clear optional parameter with a safe default and a shared args type; a maintainer must still remember copyPreviousMonth's separate filter when the rule changes again.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All actions that used getBulkEditableCategories still do; copyPreviousMonth's separate filter predates the change.

disguised_duplication.where: The parallel hidden check in copyPreviousMonth is pre-existing and visibly parallel, not reshaped by this diff.
